- Only 1 year(s) of financials available  

**Overview:**  
Mutiara Delima Agro Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company incorporated on 11 April 2023 and operates in Kuala Lumpur within the agriculture sector, focusing on oil‑palm plantation and fresh fruit bunch supply. The firm has a share capital of RM 250,000, four directors, and a single majority shareholder owning 58.92% of the equity. It was formerly known as Sejahtera Resources Sdn. Bhd., a name change recorded on 27 November 2023. Financial data show revenue of RM 74,303,529 and equity of RM 66,068,376 for the only reporting period; net profit, audit opinion and current ratio are not disclosed. No legal cases are recorded.
